from.place: ## Proof, first sentence: the proper curve C must first be shown projective, using the dimension-one quasi-projectivity input; via Stacks 09NZ as used in 0A25: the separated finite-type k-scheme X is a separated scheme, as 09NZ requires

title: A scheme separated over an affine scheme is separated
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with $S$ affine (isomorphic to $\operatorname{Spec}A$ for a commutative ring $A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]), for instance $S=\operatorname{Spec}k$ for a field $k$. If $f$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism], then $X$ is separated, i.e. its structure morphism $X\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism].

source.place: Schemes, Lemma 01KN (schemes-lemma-affine-separated: a morphism of affine schemes, in particular S -> Spec Z, is separated) and Lemma 01KU (schemes-lemma-separated-permanence, part (1): a composition of separated morphisms is separated), applied to X -> S -> Spec Z
